card.name: Drug class names in interaction lists
card.fires_on: The ending or linking word of a drug class name in a drug interaction heading or list, such as Inhibitors, Antagonists, Anticoagulants, and the word 'and' between classes.

modes.label: Class name endings
modes.description: Final piece of a drug class name like inhibitors, antagonists or anticoagulants in an interaction list.

modes.label: Links inside class lists
modes.description: A joining word or comma between drug names or classes in an interaction heading or warning.
